reason: User requested time-to-completion measurement while run-01 was still building.
appliesTo: All ten Test 2 runs; timing instrumentation began during run-01.

metrics.firstBuildResponseSeconds: Build submission to first observed completed build response. A completed response is not necessarily a usable app.
metrics.finalReviewedResultSeconds: Build submission to the final external assessment after review, corrections and cost capture.
metrics.timeToAcceptanceSeconds: Final reviewed-result duration only when the complete acceptance gate passes; otherwise unavailable.
metrics.observedApprovalWaitSeconds: Sum of observed approval boundaries to recorded approval/cancellation; partial observations are lower bounds.
metrics.recordedInterruptionSeconds: Explicitly recorded operator interruption intervals, retained within wall-clock totals.

limits: Times include service, approval, review and instrumentation delays. They are not pure model execution times. Completion is observed by polling; observation windows and missing coverage must be retained. Do not invent unobserved pilot completion times or rank historical pilot latency as directly comparable.

reason: The table-mode diagnostic timed out while awaiting a schema-read approval; its retry returned 403 because another approval was pending. This message is not proof of a tenant-admin consent requirement.
appliesTo: Scoped schema-read approvals during the continuing first run and subsequent Test 2 runs.
control: With --approve-scoped-schema, the watcher immediately approves and screenshots only an exact single Read table data schema widget for mab_benchmarkdevice or mab_benchmarkrequest. Unknown operations, additional text, multiple actions and other resources still stop for review. No tenant policies, credentials or permissions are changed.
guidanceAccounting: One authorization clarification may report that the existing approval is complete and reiterate the original authorized scope. It is not an additional defect/correction request and remains counted among the maximum two clarification replies.
timingLimit: Run-01 contains manual approval delays and harness calibration; subsequent automated approvals reduce operator waiting, so wall-clock times are not a clean model-speed comparison.
